title: EMCOR Group, Inc. Reports Third Quarter 2026 Results
summary: EMCOR Group, Inc. Reports Second Quarter 2026 Results. Browse this press release on the Company’s website at www.emcorgroup.com.
body_markdown:
# EMCOR Group, Inc. Reports Third Quarter 2026 Results


#### Revenues of $5.54 billion, 28.8% Increase Year-over-Year


#### Operating Income of $545.8 million and Operating Margin of 9.8%


#### Non-GAAP Operating Income of $579.8 million and Non-GAAP Operating Margin of 10.5%


#### Diluted EPS of $9.04, 37.6% Increase Year-over-Year


#### Non-GAAP Diluted EPS of $9.60, 46.1% Increase Year-over-Year


#### Remaining Performance Obligations of $18.57 billion, 47.2% Increase Year-over-Year


#### Increases 2026 Revenue Guidance Range to $20.6 billion - $21.0 billion from $20.0 billion - $20.5 billion


#### Increases 2026 Non-GAAP Diluted EPS Guidance Range to $34.50 - $35.50 from $32.00 - $33.25


#### Increases Share Repurchase Program $500 million
